selection_model: Independent Bernoulli exp(alpha+F phi), then deterministic 3-of-4 mask
budget: Same train candidate pool; cap 3*N_train + 4*80 gene assays plus 80 selection indicators; actual cost reported; equal cap is not equal actual spending
reference: Proxy reference records; no sample callability; PREVIOUSLY_EXPLORED; no natural theta truth
fixed_n: Uniform downsample to 40 enrolled records per environment; inadequate enrollment = capacity failure, no replacement
bootstrap: Resample patients within frozen roles, replay random assignment/selection/calibration/fit; repeated identities retain identical perturbations with multiplicity weights; 200 paired independent bootstrap runs, not 50x200
profile: G3 local constrained LR, exploratory not formal coverage; bound hit extends to infinity
primary_seed_summary: 50 perturbations are mechanism stability, not independent cohorts
auxiliary: 10 train+cal patient bootstrap source fits per cancer; fit both bounds 3 and 6, 10 model replicates per source under bounds3; evidence separate
